thought.text: Let me find the actual feature type names in the WFS52 capabilities to test a real GetFeature.

reasoning_content: The WFS 5.2 capabilities don't have any xplan52 namespaces — the schema uses a different namespace. Let's check what the actual FeatureType names inside the capabilities are. I'll search for the type names.

action.command:
python3 -c "
import re
d=open('/tmp/caps52.xml').read()
# WFS 2.0 uses <TypeName> typically; here they may be declared with qname. Search 'name=' attributes in feature type blocks.
# Print the tail of the document (type names usually listed near end or in a <FeatureTypeList>)
i=d.rfind('FeatureType')
print(d[i-300:i+500])
"
